proposal_title: Confirmation of w8 Local-Width Boundary on ECG200
comment: Reject: the preregistered success gate applies to the aggregate correct count across all five seeds, not separately to each seed. Use exactly: alpha5_w8.aggregate_qant_correct >= alpha5_w16_control.aggregate_qant_correct - 10. Keep all other corrected design details unchanged.
source: Backfilled from the already-completed review of AI Researcher v2 run #22.
